title: A proper morphism is a limit of proper morphisms over schemes of finite type over Z
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism] with $S$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then there are a directed set $\Lambda$ and an inverse system $(f_\lambda:X_\lambda\to S_\lambda)_{\lambda\in\Lambda}$ of morphisms of schemes (transition morphisms $X_\lambda\to X_\mu$, $S_\lambda\to S_\mu$ for $\lambda\ge\mu$, commuting with $f_\lambda,f_\mu$) such that: the transition morphisms $X_\lambda\to X_\mu$ and $S_\lambda\to S_\mu$ are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]; every $f_\lambda$ is proper; every $S_\lambda$ is of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]; and $(X\to S)=\varprojlim_\lambda(X_\lambda\to S_\lambda)$, i.e. $X=\varprojlim_\lambda X_\lambda$ and $S=\varprojlim_\lambda S_\lambda$ in the category of schemes [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition], with $f$ the limit of the $f_\lambda$. If moreover $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ is affine, the system can be chosen with every $S_\lambda=\operatorname{Spec}A_\lambda$ affine, $A_\lambda$ a finitely generated $\mathbf Z$-algebra (generated as a ring by finitely many elements); then $A=\varinjlim_\lambda A_\lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Lemma Tag 0A0P (lemma-proper-limit-of-proper-finite-presentation-noetherian, line 3346) and its proof (Lemma 09ZR proper-limit-of-proper-finite-presentation, absolute Noetherian approximation Proposition 01ZA, Lemmas 01ZM descend-finite-presentation and 081F eventually-proper; 'some details omitted'); the affine clause: in the proof the $S_j$ come from absolute Noetherian approximation, which for affine $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ is the system of finitely generated subrings of $A$ (proof of 01ZA), and it is the form in which Fundamental Groups, proof of Lemma 0GS2 (pione.tex, 'General case', line ~1851), cites 0A0P ('with $S_i$ affine and of finite type over $\mathbf Z$')
